def: A one-shot pruning method that sparsifies GPT-family models to 50 percent or more without retraining, by solving layer-wise sparse regression problems with approximate second-order weight updates.
practice: Pruned OPT-175B and BLOOM-176B in under 4.5 hours in the original work (Frantar and Alistarh, 2023) and also supports 2:4 and 4:8 semi-structured sparsity.
